title: Jetson Home 1.2.8 declarative schemas recovered from Hermes bytecode
description: Static reconstruction, not a vendor specification. Refinements are documented as annotations, not executable JSON Schema validation. Alternate suffixes distinguish duplicate exports; x-source-module records the compiled module as provenance only. Schema names and module IDs are not sent to the API. No routes are implied by schema presence.
